summary: Introduces the rolling_update.yml playbook and its first play, an empty-task play on monitoring hosts that exists only to gather their facts before the update.
questions: How do I gather facts from hosts without running tasks on them?
Why would a play have an empty task list?
How does Ansible orchestrate a zero-downtime upgrade?

answer_card.title: Gathering facts with an empty play
answer_card.answer_md:
`rolling_update.yml` starts with:

```yaml
- hosts: monitoring
  tasks: []
```

The play has no tasks; it just forces **fact gathering** on the monitoring servers so their facts are available to the later update play.
